name: Rose Window
description: Every key draws a turning rose whose petals are its harmonics: an organ and drone instrument of rings that open in turn, tip in the light, fold inwards, or ring as bells.

params.name: Petals
params.description: How many petals the rose has. Only the harmonics beside a multiple of it sound: three leave out every third, four leave the odd ones, many leave a few far apart.

params.name: Tracery
params.description: How the rings are built. Smooth falls outwards, Pointed lifts one ring far out, Broken lights its panes by turns, Golden bells never closes and dies away as a bell.

params.name: Heart
params.description: How loud the plain tone in the middle is against the rings. Low is hollow and glassy with the note only hinted at; high is nearly a pure tone.

params.name: Rings
params.description: How many rings stand round the heart. Each adds a pair of harmonics further out; with Pointed it moves the ring that stands out.

params.name: Reach
params.description: How much of the sound lies in the outer rings. Low stays round the heart; high lets every ring speak. With Pointed it moves the bright ring outwards.

params.name: Light
params.description: Where the sound begins to darken. Low is a window at dusk; high is clear glass. Higher keys, harder touches and a rose that has opened let more light in.

params.name: Stone
params.description: How much the stone frame takes over from the open sound. Its four fixed resonances colour every key in their own way, as a small stone room does.

params.name: Fold
params.description: Folds the petals back through the heart. New harmonics of the same family fill the rings and reach past them, and turning changes them. A harder touch folds more.

params.name: Curl
params.description: Twists the petals by how far out the rose was a moment before. The harmonics trade places into open, hollow and vowel colours that move as the rings turn.

params.name: Ring tuning
params.description: Stretches the rings sharp of their harmonics or draws them flat, the outer ones more. A little gives bars and glass, much gives gongs. The heart stays in tune.

params.name: Turn
params.description: How fast the rings turn, each key at a pace of its own, still at the centre. To the right they turn together; to the left alternate rings turn against each other.

params.name: Tilt
params.description: How far the rings tip away as they turn. A ring that tips goes dim and leans to one side while the heart comes forward. With Turn at rest it sets where they stand.

params.name: Bloom
params.description: How long the rose takes to open after a key goes down, ring by ring. With Bloom order on Passing it is the pace at which the light comes round again.

params.name: Bloom order
params.description: Heart first opens from the middle and closes from the rim. Rim first opens from the edge and loses its heart first. Passing sends a ring of light outwards over and over.

params.name: Breath
params.description: Air in the tone. It lies close round each harmonic, gusts slowly and is strongest as the key speaks; at the top little but breath on the pitch is left.

params.name: Strike
params.description: Crosses from held to struck. Low swells and holds; in the middle a strike leads into the pad; at the top only the strike sounds and dies. A bell is always struck.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long what was struck rings. Higher keys ring shorter. With Golden bells the held sound dies too, about half as fast.

params.name: Damping
params.description: How much sooner the outer rings die than the heart after a strike. Low rings bright to the end; high soaks them up, in the held sound as well.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long the held sound takes to swell in. The strike is not slowed by it.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a key let go takes to fade. The rings that opened last are gone well before.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far apart the two ears are. At the top the left and the right hear each rose a quarter turn apart; at zero both hear the same.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A key is a sum of rotors in the plane whose frequencies have the symmetry of a rosette; folding and twisting by a function of the radius keeps that symmetry. Voiced by measurement.
